title: 第十一章 祖宅藏剑第十二章 永恒剑体
content_zh:
翻出窗户，清理掉遗留痕迹，罗冠纵身跃上房檐，将自身隐入夜幕。
火焰与烟雾，很快被人发现。
“走水了！”
“快救火啊！”
严家护卫来的很快，火势爆发前便被扑灭，严都尸体被抬了出来，看着地面还未凉透的儿子，严华眼神痛苦万分。
“凶手在哪？”
护卫面如土色，“没……没发现……”
严华猛地挥手，此人头颅就像一颗熟透的西瓜，瞬间四分五裂。
“去找！”
“他逃不远！”
“抓不到凶手，你们都给少爷陪葬！”
众人惊恐四散。
严家大乱！
房檐上，罗冠神情凝重，严华打杀护卫的一击……很可怕。
“万重境！”
玄龟道：“没错。”
就在这时，严华眼眸如鹰鹫扫向四周，经过罗冠所在时，顿感针扎般刺痛，可他身体如枯木、瓦石般，纹丝不动。
徐海沉声道：“严兄，凶手得手后定已逃脱，我们分头去追。”
“劳烦徐兄！”
咻——

咻——
两人各自冲入黑夜。
心思微动，罗冠继续趴在原地。
又过了一会，两道身影自黑暗走出，赫然是刚才追出的严华、徐海。
严华脸色铁青。
徐海缓缓道：“凶手确已逃离，留下的线索也被大火损毁，想抓到很难。”略一停顿，“那明日……”
严华深吸口气，“按计划行事。”
转身就走。
徐海也未多留，皱眉离去。
对罗家动手前，严都居然被人杀了……真晦气，希望不会出意外！
又等片刻，罗冠悄无声息翻下房檐，废了一番手脚离开严家，将夜行服损毁丢进垃圾堆，他回到家中。
关上房门，给自己倒杯凉茶，一口饮尽。
“老师，十天时间，我能不能突破百夫境？”
罗家有一位万重，即便胡家来援也只有两位，可严家、清江帮联手，却有三名万重境！
罗冠思索后决定，不将此事告诉罗家众人，避免他们陷入慌乱，如今只有他修为突破，才能应对险恶局势。
玄龟道：“完美筑基带给你，远超寻常修行者的实力，可相突破难度也会提升。”
content_en:
After turning out the window and cleaning up the remaining traces, Luo Guan jumped up to the eaves, hiding himself into the night.
The flames and smoke were quickly discovered.
"It's gone!"
"Quickly put out the fire!"
The guards of the Yan family came quickly and put out the fire before it broke out. Yan Du's body was carried out. Looking at his son who was still on the ground, Yan Hua's eyes were filled with pain.
"Where is the murderer?"
The guard's face turned pale, "I didn't... didn't find it..."
Yan Hua waved his hand violently, and the man's head was like a ripe watermelon, splitting into pieces in an instant.
"Go find it!"
"He can't escape far!"
"If the murderer is not caught, you will all be buried with the young master!"
Everyone dispersed in fear.
The Yan family is in chaos!
On the eaves, Luo Guan looked solemn, and Yan Hua's blow to kill the guard... was terrible.
"Ten Thousand Levels Realm!"
Xuangui said: "That's right."
At this moment, Yan Hua's eyes swept around like an eagle. When he passed by Luo Guan, he suddenly felt a stinging pain like needles, but his body was as motionless as dead wood or tiles.
Xu Hai said in a deep voice: "Brother Yan, the murderer must have escaped after he succeeded. Let's go after him separately."
"Excuse me, Brother Xu!"
Phew——
Phew——
The two of them rushed into the night.
With his thoughts moving slightly, Luo Guan continued to lie on the spot.
After a while, two figures walked out of the darkness. They were Yan Hua and Xu Hai who had been chased out just now.
Yan Hua's face was ashen.
Xu Hai said slowly: "The murderer has indeed escaped, and the clues left behind have been destroyed by the fire. It will be difficult to catch him." After a brief pause, "Then tomorrow..."
Yan Hua took a deep breath and said, "Act as planned."
Turn around and leave.
Xu Hai didn't stay long, frowned and left.
Before taking action against the Luo family, Yan Du was actually killed... What bad luck, I hope nothing happens!
After waiting for a while, Luo Guan quietly climbed down the eaves, left Yan's house with all his hands and feet, destroyed his night clothes and threw them into the garbage, and returned home.
Close the door, pour yourself a cup of herbal tea, and drink it all in one gulp.
"Teacher, in ten days, can I break through to the Hundred Man Realm?"
The Luo family has one million-level person, and even if the Hu family comes to help, there are only two, but the Yan family and the Qingjiang Gang join forces, but there are three ten-thousand-level members!
After thinking about it, Luo Guan decided not to tell everyone in the Luo family about this to prevent them from panic. Now only his breakthrough in cultivation can help him deal with the dangerous situation.
Xuangui said: "Perfect foundation building brings you strength that far exceeds that of ordinary practitioners, but the difficulty of breaking through will also increase."
